cta: NRG Bloom is building a voice that can compare Permian scale with African field execution honestly.

scenes.text: If your stranded-gas thesis has no view on Texas, it probably has no view on scale.
Texas produced record natural gas volumes in 2024, and the Permian drove most U.S. production growth.
EIA data shows Texas and the Permian remain central to U.S. gas-growth dynamics.
That scale explains why modular power and compute operators keep showing up in and around Texas-linked energy infrastructure.
NRG Bloom should use Texas as a scale analog, then explain why African execution demands a different field operating model.
The real signal from Texas is not hype. It is that scale belongs to operators who move at the speed of the basin.
Know Texas for scale. Know Africa for execution. Win by understanding both.

title: If You Want Scale, You Have to Understand Texas
